t: 2030 — First governed research hulls field trials: research logistics m
title: 2030 — First governed research hulls field trials: research logistics m
definition: 2030 milestone on the Hurricane Modification Research roadmap.
description:
First governed research hulls field trials: research logistics monitoring published openly, ethics review oversight in place.

What must be true first: the storm models results have to replicate outside the lab, research logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and ethics review operations need a year of continuous runtime. Signals to watch: peer-reviewed storm models demonstrations, research logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting ethics review uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Hurricane Modification Research
definition: Estimates Hurricane Modification Research readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Hurricane Modification Research components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a research hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Hurricane Modification Research Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Hurricane Modification Research operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Hurricane Modification Research installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 49321 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where storm models monitoring, research logistics redundancy, or ethics review maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Hurricane Modification Research Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Hurricane Modification Research: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Hurricane Modification Research — research on weakening hurricanes.

Phase 1 — Prove (storm models): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (research logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (ethics review): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (field limits): research hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and academia-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
